identity.join_rule: Validate year, contract and three-character plan ID; pad segment to three digits only for comparison. Preserve every original value and its JSON type. Join all four fields; filename alone never proves payload identity.
identity.grain: Landscape row: release/year/contract/plan/segment/state/county-label. PBP member in this release: one plan-segment payload; never a geographic offering.

part_c_premium.meaning: Published Part C basic plus mandatory supplemental premium, net of rebates; not the person's complete premium obligation.

part_d_basic_premium.meaning: Published basic Part D component net of rebates. Parenthesized negatives are real source values, not invalid premiums.

part_d_supplemental_premium.meaning: Published supplemental Part D component net of rebates.

part_d_total_premium.meaning: Published basic plus supplemental Part D premium, net of rebates.

consolidated_premium.meaning: Part C plus Part D total only when both apply. Preserve Not Applicable for PDP and MA-only; do not call it zero or total Medicare cost.

annual_part_d_deductible.documentation: Landscape README field list and Note 06
annual_part_d_deductible.meaning: Published Part D deductible, not proof that a particular medicine is covered or subject to it.

in_network_medical_moop.meaning: Published in-network Part A/B service limit in selected HMO/HMO-POS/PPO scope. Does not cap premiums, Part D or all expenses. No PBP band is substituted.

null_policy: Each cell keeps raw + state. Distinguish value (including zero), empty/whitespace, Not Applicable, Not Available, JSON null, absent path and rejected value. Sentinel labels are source tokens; their domain-specific reasons are not invented.
geography: Explicit versioned county aliases verified against pinned Census file. Statewide PDP records keep source scope All Counties and exact state. No ZIP-to-county or residence eligibility claim.
uninterpreted: PBP status Submitted is an observed workflow token, not approval/marketability. Coded nested benefits, moopLimits bands, deletion codes and timestamps remain source evidence. No undocumented benefit-code decoding or timezone conversion.
lineage: Top-level release manifest pins archive hashes/URLs. Each cell identifies artifact, member, member hash, data-record ordinal (header=1; first data record=2) and column or JSON pointer. Ordinals are CSV records, not physical lines.
